description: Extract a podcast-ready MP3 from any prior Weftly job that holds a video — an uploaded source (transcribe, summarize, find_clips) or a video Weftly delivered (extract_clip, extract_vertical_clip, edit_from_transcript, edit_from_multiple_cameras, a clips bundle); possessing the parent `source_job_id` is the capability, no upload step. Single call: pass `source_job_id` (plus `output_role` only if the parent delivered more than one video, e.g. a clips bundle) to create and start the job immediately — Free, so there is no payment step and no job_id/payment_credential round trip. Output: role `podcast-audio`, MP3 96 kbps mono 44.1 kHz, loudness-normalized to -16 LUFS integrated / -1.5 dBTP true peak (Apple's published podcast target, distinct from the -14 LUFS video/social target used elsewhere), with optional `title`/`artist`/`album`/`date` written as ID3v2.3 tags — an absent field writes no tag. get_job_status returns `bytes` and `duration_seconds` once complete, ready for a feed's `<enclosure length>` and `itunes:duration`. Free — no Stripe Checkout, no MPP challenge, no payment required. Use whenever a video already processed by Weftly also needs to ship as an audio-only episode. Source must still be in storage (24h TTL for most parents, 72h for find_clips/edit_from_multiple_cameras parents — check `expires_at` from get_job_status on the parent).
name: audio_from_job
